data.message: Individual opt-in, not all-or-nothing: I commit to request 18 tons; each of the other 24, please state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. You may choose18 even if others choose10.
